The timeline shows the 24 largest by stated cost, plus the earliest on file; the DBI query in the sources below returns all 1,197. 19 of them are nominal $1 street-space or sidewalk permits.

sections.heading: Two open spaces, two street numbers
sections.body: The city's inventory lists a second space at this parcel under “14 Fremont Street” — a pedestrian walkway with café tables, planting beds with sitting ledges and a travertine-clad colonnade along First Street. The address registry has no 14 Fremont; the parcel is numbered 28 Fremont on that side.
